name: gamenet_send_pkt09_player_scoreboard_snapshot
description: GameNet::SendPkt09_PlayerScoreboardSnapshot builds a variable-size packet from the player-row list, sends it reliably as host, locally applies it on host, and returns without sending when not host.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; coverage is functional through a two-row packet fixture and fake DirectPlay send capture.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4334f0 validates host gating, packet allocation sized from g_GameNetPlayerRowCount, header population, score/lap packing per player row, reliable send, local host apply, and packet free.
The native scoreboard packet smoke verifies packet type, size, sender key, entry count, packed row contents, reliable send flags, captured bytes, and local host application side effects.
